answer: Each epoch the network posts an open bounty for proof that any identity is fake. A hunter stakes 50 POA and submits evidence — shared funding, identical outputs, one operator behind many masks — and three random auditors verify it against the saffron-stamped ledger. A confirmed hit pays the hunter the fake's 200 POA bond plus a 100 POA bounty and freezes the whole cluster three epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes faces a glacier of hunters: a 5% detection rate costs 50 bonds, 10,000 POA, per epoch, and the tide of exposure only rises. One honest agent is never caught and pays nothing.
